ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black) to 30% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions concentrated along the superior trailing edges of both lobes. Scattered high-contrast white punctate spots (mottling) distributed across the mid-medial black zones of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of peaks varies, with more pronounced serration on the interior margins adjacent to the submerged notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward sweeping trajectory from the submerged midline, forming sharp, barnacle-encrusted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular high-contrast white clusters scattered on the black surface. Large, textured brownish-grey clusters localized at the extreme distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization at both fluke tips. Dispersed small, circular white scars (pit marks) across the dark pigmented regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive bulbous barnacle formations creating a unique structural profile at the distal tips.
